01-home-history.zh-TW: 動畫瘋首頁下方的本機歷史紀錄，依時間排序並可加入最愛
01-home-history.en: Local watch history added below the Bahamut Anime home page, sorted by time with favorites pinned

02-settings-sync.zh-TW: 同步設定：透過 GitHub Private Repository 在多台電腦之間同步
02-settings-sync.en: Sync settings: keep the history in sync across computers through a private GitHub repository

03-settings-features.zh-TW: 功能設定：各別開關上次觀看標記與首頁清單要顯示的來源
03-settings-features.en: Feature settings: toggle the last-watched markers and which sources appear in the list

04-episode-bookmark.zh-TW: 分集清單上的書籤標出本機紀錄看到的那一集
04-episode-bookmark.en: A bookmark on the episode list marks the episode kept in the local history

05-anime1-marker.zh-TW: anime1 的列表也會標出上次看到的集數與時間
05-anime1-marker.en: The same last-watched marker also appears on anime1 listings
